model.name: PUMA Speedcat Etoile - Women's
model.description:
The PUMA Speedcat Etoile-Mnt reimagines racing heritage through the lens of a chic ballet flat. These sleek kicks feature a premium leather base with a classic formstrip and embroidered branding for a sophisticated look that stays true to its motorsport roots. Designed with a low-vamp silhouette and secure ribbon lace-up closure, these shoes provide a snug fit and cushioned comfort for all-day wear.

  • Leather upper with leather overlays provides durability and style
  • Embroidered PUMA branding on the toe and quarter panel adds detail
  • Closed mesh lining offers breathability for long-lasting comfort
  • OrthoLite footbed delivers responsive cushioning with every step
  • Rubber outsole ensures reliable traction and stability

Material & Care
  • 68% leather/32% textile upper
  • Rubber outsole

Size & Fit
  • Low-vamp ballet flat design
  • Lace-up closure for a secure and adjustable fit
